1356.0.0.description:
Log TestSuite PostRun failure for results publishing

Test-harness step (not a functional test): logs the test-suite post-run outcome for results publishing. Excluded from manual-test coverage mapping.

1356.1001.0.description:
Log TestSet setup outcome

Test-harness step (not a functional test): logs the per-test-set setup outcome before the set's functional cases run. Excluded from manual-test coverage mapping.

1356.1001.1.description:
Test gets the api schema from dut and attempts http get for all possible urls derived from schema

[Log-derived analysis] Exercises the device's full REST/management API surface for reachability and stability. Retrieves the API schema from the DUT, derives every possible URL from it, and performs an HTTP GET against each one, collecting any HTTP errors returned. Checks that free memory does not drop significantly across the full API walk (including after the first call), so that walking the entire schema does not leak memory or destabilise the device.

1356.1001.2.description:
Test tries a false credential to login 100 times and checks for server still accessible

[Log-derived analysis] Verifies the management API is hardened against repeated failed logins. Attempts to retrieve the API schema many times using invalid credentials, then confirms the server is still reachable with valid credentials afterwards. Checks that free memory does not drop significantly across the failed attempts or between a failed and a successful connection, so that brute-force login attempts cannot exhaust device resources.

1356.1001.3.description:
Test generates a firewall rule via command line and removes it via API and confirms the deletion is reflected in config

[Log-derived analysis] Confirms that configuration created via the CLI can be removed through the API and that the change is reflected consistently. Creates a firewall rule from the command line, deletes it via the API, and verifies the rule is gone from the running configuration. Also checks free memory stays stable across the operation.

1356.1001.4.description:
Test creates a auto-generated config based on XML schema for firewall and posts it to device and verifies its applied correctly

[Log-derived analysis] Validates that API-driven configuration round-trips correctly using schema-derived data. Auto-generates a firewall-rule config object from the XML schema, posts it to the device via the API, reads it back, and confirms the applied configuration matches what was sent before removing the rule. Also checks free memory stays stable.

1356.1001.5.description:
Test creates a corrupt gui file and test that the the api still works

[Log-derived analysis] Confirms the management API remains functional even when the device GUI resource file is damaged. Disables HTTP, plants a corrupt GUI file, re-enables HTTP, then retrieves and parses the API schema and browses a random sample of API URLs, verifying the API still serves valid responses despite the broken GUI file.

1356.1001.6.description:
Test generates a ipv4 static route description in CLI and check that is present in the API

[Log-derived analysis] Verifies parity between the CLI/running-configuration and the API for IPv4 static routes, including persistence across reboot. Creates a static route with a description from the CLI and confirms it appears in both the running-config and the API, removes it and confirms it disappears from both, then creates it via the API and confirms it appears in both. Reboots the device and confirms the route and its description persist in both the running-config and the API.

1356.1001.100.description:
Confirm that latest Device GUI file runs and presents login page, and release and gui file size are not too big

[Log-derived analysis] Confirms the latest device GUI (web management) file is healthy and that the device has adequate flash headroom. Disables the GUI and clears resource files, re-enables the GUI so the file is downloaded, waits for the webgui to initialise, and verifies it presents a login page. Also checks that the release and GUI file sizes are within limits — confirming there is room to store two release files plus the GUI and additional reserved space in flash.

1356.1001.101.description:
Confirm that Device GUI file runs and permits login

[Log-derived analysis] Confirms the device GUI (web management) file runs and supports authentication. Disables the GUI and clears resource files, re-enables the GUI so it is downloaded, waits for it to initialise, verifies it presents a login page, and then confirms the GUI successfully processes a login.

1356.1001.53752.description:
Check combined file size of GUI and release is not too big

[Log-derived analysis] Confirms the combined on-device footprint of the GUI and release files stays within flash limits. Refreshes the GUI resource file and checks that the device has enough flash to hold two release files plus the GUI plus reserved space, guarding against images that are too large to fit.

1356.1001.73933.description:
Check the API reports the same free RAM as the CLI

[Log-derived analysis] Verifies that the free RAM reported through the API matches what the CLI reports. Reads free RAM from both the API and the CLI and confirms the two values agree within a small tolerance, ensuring the API exposes accurate memory telemetry.
